subject.title: Add the Maven wrapper (mvnw) to this repo for contributors
subject.author: shossain786
subject.body:
New contributors who use IntelliJ without a system Maven install have to set Maven up locally before they can build.

**Acceptance criteria**
- `mvnw`, `mvnw.cmd` and `.mvn/wrapper/` are committed.
- `./mvnw test` passes on a clean checkout with only JDK 17.
- CONTRIBUTING / README build steps mention `./mvnw`. Plain `mvn` keeps working, and CI is unchanged.

Suggested by @PUSHPAK-JAISWAL.
